title: Maryland governor’s AI framework focuses on regulation and reskilling
summary: While the framework Gov. Wes Moore established begins with forming committees and gathering stakeholders, Maryland already has one law regulating the technology at work.

title: Judge tosses former Purdue diversity chief’s race bias and retaliation claims
summary: The executive offered up three colleagues as similarly situated comparators — and the judge dismissed all three.

title: Workers say they are frustrated by bait-and-switch job descriptions
summary: When a role's responsibilities don’t match hiring language or a position’s expectations change significantly, it can lead to stress and burnout, employees reported.

title: Older workers struggle to showcase their true skills on freelancing platforms, study says
summary: As the workforce ages, HR may need to go the extra mile to connect with talent that has the skills they need.

title: HR leaders worry about the loss of critical leadership skill development
summary: The entry-level worker pipeline is shrinking and more tasks are being given to artificial intelligence, resulting in fewer learning opportunities for younger workers, a report found.

title: Teen’s ‘therapeutic’ DJ classes did not entitle mother to FMLA leave, court finds
summary: While the mother, a Mattress Firm manager, said the classes were related to her son’s mental health, the court noted they had not been prescribed.

title: Colorado judge: Doctor’s burnout wasn’t a disability
summary: The Americans with Disabilities Act and related federal laws define disability broadly, but recent federal court decisions demonstrate the statute’s limits.

title: Religious bias requires more than knowledge of employee’s accommodation need, court says
summary: Federal courts have been asked in recent months to decide what counts as sufficient disclosure of an employees’ religious beliefs, particularly in the COVID-19 vaccination context.

title: Why aren’t women applying? It may be due to a lack of representation.
summary: In an Emory University study, women survey-takers seemed discouraged from applying for jobs that were perceived as lacking gender diversity.

title: Week in review: Employers need more ‘bench strength’
summary: We’re rounding up last week’s top stories, including the percentage of Generation Z workers that said they intend to look for a new role before the year is through.
